```{r}
sample_ps <- function(ps, FUN = sample, ...){
  ids <- sample_names(ps)
  sampled_ids <- FUN(ids, ...)
  ps <- prune_samples(sampled_ids, ps)
  return(ps)
}
```


```{r}
path <- "../data/D003934_Diabetes_Mellitus,_T/species/phyloseq.RData"

ps <- get(load(path))
sample_data(ps)
```

```{r}
ps_IBD_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_IBD, function(x) x / sum(x))
otu_IBD_rel <- as(otu_table(ps_IBD_rel), "matrix") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
meta_IBD_rel <- as(sample_data(ps_IBD_rel), "matrix") %>% as.data.frame()
tax_IBD_rel <- as(tax_table(ps_IBD_rel), "matrix") %>% as.data.frame()  

ps_IBD_genus <- tax_glom(ps_IBD_rel, taxrank = "Genus")

ps_IBD_genus_sampled <- sample_ps(ps_IBD_genus, FUN = sample, size = 80)

plot_bar(ps_IBD_genus_sampled, fill = "Genus") +
  facet_nested(~ Disease.MESH.ID, scales = "free_x") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

ps_IBD_sick <- subset_samples(ps_IBD_genus, Sex %in% c('Male', 'Female'))
ps_IBD_healthy <- subset_samples(ps_IBD_genus, Disease.MESH.ID %in% c('D006262'))

sum(!is.na(meta_IBD_rel['Host.age']))
```
